subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should session workspace listings ever expose existence or metadata for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary, or should those entries be hidden/neutral while only in-root files and folders get resolved state?
rationale: The remaining false Missing behavior can be fixed in more than one way, but the unsafe-looking path is a product/security boundary choice rather than an automation-only patch shape.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected transcript paths stay hidden or neutral, and the bug is fixed by filtering, directory-aware in-root semantics, or clearer UI state.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The Gateway may report existence and basic metadata for transcript-mentioned external paths, but that needs explicit tests and documented security semantics before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected transcript paths stay hidden or neutral, and the bug is fixed by filtering, directory-aware in-root semantics, or clearer UI state.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace browsing and preview boundary work makes this the clearest owner for the fs-safe metadata decision.
